notes: Encoded from MoistAir's own page only; NOT usesStylesOf (the header brand list alone does not establish shared-system reuse). Page body describes Champion Cooler brand equipment and states Champion Cooler is a subsidiary of Essick Air Products, Inc. Month is chart-only, so this style ships year-only.

styles.notes: Page positions 2nd & 3rd numerical digits = year (normalized [1,3] -> '07' -> 2007). COUNTING: character counting ships — the page's own italicized grouping '*E07*141664' groups E07 as the prefix, so the year digits are the '07' of that group; digit-only counting would give '71' (the 7 of the prefix group plus the 1 of the sequence), crossing the page's own grouping. Month = 1st letter, chart-only in image Champion_Essick-Air_Spec-Air-Serial-Number-Style-1_How-to-determine-the-date-of-manufacture-or-age.png, held for the image pass, so year-only.
